To take the easy way out

questions.questionText:

the blank.

________sentence.
options: light: any device serving as a source of illumination
light: the energy from the sun
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in positive degree of
comparison. She is liked by everybody as she is so good.
options: She is good because everybody likes her.
She is liked by everybody for being good.
Everybody like her as she is good.
She is so good that everybody likes her.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (D).

questions.questionText:

The book was written over a period of two years.
The book was being written by the author over a period of two years.
The period of two years was taken by the author to write the book.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).
